environment: Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.248, Create 6.0.10, Java 21; dedicated server with minimal Create dependencies, not full Mechanomania.

machine.construction: press and shaft were previously planned and placed by the conversation agent; depot and collector were added through scoped MCP construction

first_run.input_fixture: one iron ingot summoned by the isolated server console; no MCP command or world-write gate was enabled

restart_run.input_fixture: one iron ingot summoned by isolated console with collector hopper disabled

telemetry.sampling: three positions with intervalTicks=20; actual per-position samples were further apart
telemetry.history: memory and asynchronous disk history queried via MCP
telemetry.latest_kinetic: after a later restart, the press point returned -8 RPM and utilization 0.5 derived from cached 128/256 SU
telemetry.flow_measurement: not implemented; inventory observation is not a general flow meter

performance.tick_query_earlier: target 20 TPS; mean 0.2 ms/tick, P95 0.4 ms, P99 1.0 ms over 100 ticks
performance.two_monitor_comparison: Paused: mean 0.1 ms, P95 0.2 ms, P99 0.3 ms; running: mean 0.1 ms, P95 0.3 ms, P99 0.3 ms; each 100 ticks, target 20 TPS.
performance.journal_growth: Approximately 381123 bytes between two observations about 76 seconds apart with both monitors resumed; includes all journal records, not just one monitor.
performance.limits: Small short sequential samples; no full-pack performance, per-sample attribution, write-latency, memory, GC or long-run benchmark.

cycle_time: Exact cycle start/end were not instrumented. Input and output sample ticks bound observations but do not establish exact processing duration.
limits: Full Mechanomania has not been launched or verified in this test.
No in-game tachometer or stressometer comparison.
One ingot per run; not a sustained production benchmark.
Mod and data-pack recipe context is this minimal server only.
No claim of real transfer metering or inferred factory production rate.
evidence: integration-test/evidence/v1-agent-calls.jsonl (local ignored file); isolated server console recorded the two summons and tick query.
